As somebody who has played every SE except the first one all the way thru multiple times, and has played multiplayer and coop in most of them, I am conflicted on how to review this. I really like the game. I like the missions, I like how Harry has his own game now after being a side character for pretty much the entire series, I like gun selection and how they're are different than the ones we have had before. However the game is currently a buggy and unbalanced mess. It has all the bugs SE5 had and more. On top of that, gun customization no longer feels balanced and leads to certain playstyles being obsolete. I play the game in a custom difficulty somewhere between Hard and Authentic and I hate how many times I have had to restart levels because of some bug making objectives impossible/getting me stuck in geometry or some gun not working as it should. If these are fixed then the game would be an 8/10 for me. The remaining two points I deduct because of pretty sub par graphics especially anti-aliasing, and because I just hate the stealth propaganda missions lol. Buy if you like the previous SE games and have regional pricing/catch a discount, don't if you arent obsessed with SE.

Folks, I bought this game to keep my library complete and up to date with the "Sniper Elite" series and all DLC, but paid somewhere in the 80.00+ dollar range.  The game seems like nothing more than new - not quite complete maps, to the original game play, basically could be Sniper Elite 4 or 5 and you wouldn't really notice much difference.  More than a few times I got stuck between walls or corners, requiring killing the game and restarting.  I found myself losing tons of play time unless I saved often, but many times, I would forget.  Many vehicles are unable to be messed with, maybe sound distraction but no destruction or booby trap, etc.  You can walk around them fully, they are in the map, not eye candy over the wall so-to-speak.  So otherwise, I bought the grand slam, couldn't spend more if I wanted, and got something that should be a DLC for Sniper Elite 5.  I love the series and at one point, before they cheated on the leader board, I was at #17 or #27, don't remember, but my point is, I put months of play time into the series, I have personal reasons for the time available to play, but I sure wish these folks would have stepped up and delivered some real content...

it's more Sniper Elite. If you liked any of the previous games, you'll probably like this. Though the series does start to feel a bit stale and stagnant at this point - no features added compared to SE5, grenade shots still dissapointingly missing (like in SE5)... And most of all, the movement really feels a bit too limiting at this point: it seems random what walls/fences you can or can't climb over, you sometimes can't get around obstacles when it looks like you should, and there were also a couple of invisible barrier bugs (mostly related to stairs) where you could get stuck for no discernible reason.
Fans of the series will want to play this at some point I guess, but it really seems time for some slightly more substantial changes to the formula.

Sniper Elite: Resistance delivers exactly what longtime fans of the series crave—more of that signature stealth-sniping gameplay with expansive maps and satisfying ballistics. While it doesn’t reinvent the wheel, it captures the essence of what makes the franchise enjoyable. The gunplay is as smooth as ever, and lining up the perfect shot remains as rewarding as it was in previous entries. Sure, some elements feel familiar, and I understand the criticism regarding asset reuse, but for me, that’s not a dealbreaker. This game scratches that inevitable Sniper Elite itch, filling the gap between major releases with a solid, well-paced experience.

That said, I do wish the story had more depth, and it’s a shame there wasn’t a proper cinematic sequence for the earthquake bomb mission—those big moments deserve more weight. The technical issues, while noticeable, never significantly hindered my enjoyment. My biggest gripe is the new protagonist; Karl Fairburne’s absence is definitely felt, as the new character lacks the same presence that made previous games so immersive. Still, despite these minor setbacks, Resistance fits well within the series and is an easy recommendation for any Sniper Elite fan. If you’re here for the sniping and tactical gameplay, you won’t be disappointed.

Sniper Elite: Resistance really feels like more of a good thing. If you've played Sniper Elite 5 and want more, than this game is definitely for you. 

Sniper Elite: Resistance is almost identical in terms of gameplay to the 5th entry, continuing with the use of discoverable workbenches for attachments, weapon unlocks through kill challenges, and open-ended missions. These join the hallmarks like the slo-mo kill cam. The stealth continues to be intuitive, if unimaginative, though the cover feature remains a bit buggy. The gunplay is still excellent, and the sniping mechanics still work quite well. On the newer front, the propaganda missions are a fun arcade-y distraction, consisting of attempting to kill as many marked enemies within a time limit. 

The graphics, though showing their age, continue to impress, with most of the maps taking place in either towns or the french countryside, and typically showcasing castles and cathedrals. I encountered several lighting bugs however,  especially on one level set during a rainy night. 

Storywise, the game is serviceable. It's the typical "track down the secret nazi macguffin, and destroy it!", as well as the standard kill Hitler mission. There's no major flaws here, but there's also nothing standout. 

Overall, the game remains very enjoyable to those who like either sniping games, or hitman-esque open world stealth games. If you've played Sniper Elite 5 and want more, this game is well worth it, otherwise, it's a toss up between the two. Still, would definitely recommend.

UPDATE - HITLER DLC - Finished it on the 1st run through in 16 minutes, seriously. It looked like so much fun. So beautiful , but so predictable. From the 1st tower I carefully removed every single german I could. Then I went to the bridge because the voice said "this person has something I need"  When I got there I went down the stairs and headed back to where there was a "inspect prompt. No one around.....READ MY REVIEW....walked around until I saw Mercedes...yea, Hitler standing there. Over....and literally ran to the nearest exit. Game over 16 minutes. THAT folks, is the best summary I can give you of my detailed review below. 


People, I like many of you really love the Sniper Elite series. I have logged literally hundreds of hours. I really want to understand why my experience from the onset of resistance was so poor. Here is what I found, written out for the developers because this game needs help or it will ruin the franchise. Chapter 1 is so boring that it smacks your oldest players right in the face....SO....BORING!

1. GHOST TOWN - Way too few Germans everywhere! You should immediately double the number Germans in every chapter. We are skilled players and there is little challenge to be found anywhere in Resistance. It is as if you forgot all that you learned about NUMBERS MATTER.

2. TANKS, ARMOR CARS, STATIC TURRETS, MACHINE GUN NESTS- Simply put a huge FAIL. If this is an important operation where are the typical SE defenses? Truck arriving with Germans. NEVER, in fact the state truck filled with Germans waiting for a grenade is...is...idiotic! Drop these things in throughout the next release. ONE TANK      

3. FALSE ADVERTISING POSTER CHILD? The one we all see of the brit standing on a sloped roof. Not ONCE, not EVER was there the ability to do what you needed to show to generate excitement and then failed to provide....the means to get on roofs, cross all the medium barriers, this game paths like a train. Why? Who designed this game? Did they play any of the others?

4. MAIN LEAD vs BRITISH BOREDOM - From dialog to weapons, boring boring boring. All the snap was gone. I barely upgraded my weapons as every table I stopped at gave me ONE goofy thing! Dialog was child like. Why? Why did you do this? Certainly not for the story line....Certainly not for the devices. Why? God knows.

5. LARGE MAPS EMPTY EXCITEMENT - Yes some of them are gorgeous! Not one of them has the density of engagement with the enemy that makes for a game. 

6. VILLAINS? - Nope not in this game. Nothing personal to talk about and certainly no German worth dialog lines. Seriously, Chinese developers? 

7. GERMAN SNIPERS NEED NOT APPLY - All those windows in all those buildings in all the chapters and there were no more than 3 snipers to be found and THEY WERE SO OBVIOUS is was ridiculous.

Never once felt concerned that I needed to rig a pathway in or out of anywhere
Never had to sneak around anything
Never care about the weapons
Never cared about upgrading past the 12x scope went though the whole game with a 5 round rifle clip.

So....I am concerned that you folks just put the franchise at risk. You need to do the following:

1 - Double the Germans
2.- Triple the vehicles
3. Quadruple the German Snipers
4.  Figure out something challenging! Dogs, Planes. whatever.

And finally dump the non-lethal, non American, no story nonsense that somehow found its way into this one.

Sniper Elite is a great series, the graphics, sound and gameplay are all on point.  I immediately bought the game given its consistently fun and engaging scenarios.  BUT... as many have said, and I have to agree to, there's far too much rinse and repeat this time around, there's nothing new to talk about, the maps feel much smaller and linear and two of the maps literally have the same assets in them albeit set out in a different way.  Its clear that the devs chose to go the easy and cheap way with this game, and it is true that it feels more like an expansion dlc for Sniper Elite 5.  I love playing this game and the series as a whole, but the devs need to wake up now and bring some new aspects to the game.  Some big and beautiful fresh maps for a start.   Oh and what's with the peculiar voice acting this time around?  the guy sounds as hard as my pillow!  This is the turning point, people won't sit back and buy the next version of Sniper Elite if its more of this, mediocre copy and paste formula.   If you love Sniper Elite 5 this is still a great game.
